text: Enter the lobby from an Episode Gate to create or join an episode room.
Quest and episode information is available on the guide board.
Items and TAFF from auctions that went unsold, were won, or were cancelled disappear if not collected within 3 days.
Items dropped by monsters are picked up automatically.
If you finish an episode with a failing grade (F), you get no items or EXP.
Use the phone for one-on-one chats with friends, sending messages, talking to NPCs and more.
If your character can no longer move, try the /escape command to break free.
Skills can be learned from NPCs inside the school.
When you play, set yourself a time limit and take regular breaks.
